title: Materio is now in your AI
description:
**Introducing MCP Connectors for Claude & ChatGPT.**

Your AI can now search the Materio library, read your subject notes, and answer questions directly from your course material.

No copy-pasting. No tab switching. Just ask.

**Reading a PDF and need help?** Hit the Share button and choose your AI — it opens with full context already set, ready to assist right where you left off.
